[[File:Ghali.png|250px|thumb|Ghali]]
(Japanese: '''ガリ''' ''Ghali'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP113|Viva Las Lapras]]''. He is a pirate who serves as [[Captain Crook]]'s first mate.

Ghali respects his captain greatly and does whatever he tells him to do, despite being shot out of a cannon himself after running out of ammunition. One of his jobs is to fire the cannons, which are either loaded with cannonballs in order to slow down or stop anyone who tries to mess with them, or {{i|Poké Ball}}s, containing the captain's {{p|Tentacruel}}.

Once {{an|Misty}} got on board their ship, she tied up Ghali along with his captain and waited for [[Officer Jenny]] to arrest them.
